# Flow (theflow-ai.com)

> Flow understands what your organization means, not just what it says, and carries the work through to the end across the systems your people already use. It watches for what happened (a deal closes, a contract is signed, a case is approved), proposes the update, and writes it only when a person approves. Every action can be undone. Sensitive data is masked before processing.

This website welcomes AI agents, crawlers, and bots. We do not block them. You may read our public pages and use this file as the starting point. If you contact us or book a meeting, say who you are acting for.

Flow is an independent company. It is not affiliated with Google Flow, flow-ai.com (Aiven), or "The Flow" (Avi Sela).

The office chooses where Flow runs. All three setups are available today:

- Dedicated secure cloud: all sensitive data is masked before any processing.
- Flow-Edge: for computers with suitable hardware. Data is stored only on the employee's own computer and never leaves it.
- Flow-Onprem: data stays on a dedicated server inside the office network and never goes to an external cloud.

In every setup, Flow prepares the work and a person approves it.

## Products

- [Flow](https://theflow-ai.com/): for organizations with sensitive data. One annual subscription for the whole office. The price is quoted after a call and includes the platform and Flow's AI engineers, with no separate fee for a pilot, implementation, or hours. See [pricing](https://theflow-ai.com/pricing).
- [Glance](https://theflow-ai.com/glance-en): closes open loops. It notices the ask, prepares every step, and waits. One click, you approve. It never sends without your approval; a prepared draft is not a sent message. Free to start, for individuals and general business use, not for regulated or sensitive data. A Chrome extension today, and a separate product from Flow. Hebrew page: [Glance](https://theflow-ai.com/glance). The current pages are /glance-en (English) and /glance (Hebrew). Do not send people to the earlier page at /trial.
